sourceGap: No cited operative passage currently states that successful Lich transformation changes the character's mechanical creature type. The separately selected Mage 16 Undead Immunities card does not itself grant taxonomy. This proposal supplies a clearly labeled NEW candidate rule only.

proposedRule.label: NEW — proposed for owner review; not accepted or operative

eligibility.subject: An active Humanoid Mage at Mage class level 10 or higher who does not already have the Undead creature type.
readiness: Obtain either one Soul Coin or two ritual participants.
Bind at least two named mini-bosses as guardians.
existingModifiers: A third bound guardian grants +2 to the final ritual check.
If both ritual participants are willing, the final ritual check has advantage.
eligibility.accessAndTiming: All readiness conditions must be satisfied before the final Lich ritual check. The Director must disclose the historical failure stakes and obtain the player's explicit opt-in before the irreversible roll. If the player declines, stop before rolling and follow the existing alternative-Hero-path instruction.

paymentAndConsumptionClarification.status: NEW proposal to make the existing readiness wording deterministic; requires separate owner review.
paymentAndConsumptionClarification.soulCoinRoute: The acquired Soul Coin is a readiness prerequisite checked before the final roll. This proposed addition does not consume, destroy, transfer or spend it, and adds no RP, casting Action, component or other payment for the taxonomy change.
paymentAndConsumptionClarification.participantRoute: The two participants must be available to participate in the ritual at the final check. Their participation is not itself a consumable payment under this proposal. The existing willingness condition and advantage rule remain unchanged.
paymentAndConsumptionClarification.failureTiming: No additional cost is introduced by this taxonomy proposal on a failed check. Existing historical failure consequences remain exactly as the cited source states; this proposal does not override them.

checkAndResolution.check: After all readiness gates and the divine-echo encounter are complete, roll d20 + Intelligence modifier + Constitution modifier against DC 20, applying the existing third-guardian +2 and willing-participant advantage where applicable.
checkAndResolution.successTiming: Immediately after successful resolution of the final check, add Undead to the same character's creature-type set. The type update is one atomic rules-state update; it does not create a second creature or body.
checkAndResolution.failure: The existing historical failure state and agreed player-to-NPC handoff remain unchanged. The proposed taxonomy addition does not occur on failure.

identityAndBodyMapping.identity: Preserve the same creature identity and character record.
identityAndBodyMapping.bodyAndLifeState: Continue the same extant body and same active creature life state; the character is alive, not a corpse. Do not create a replacement body, death, corpse, resurrection or separate creature.
identityAndBodyMapping.positionOrientationAndVolume: Preserve the exact position, orientation, occupied volume and current spatial relation before and after the type update. No movement, crossing, admission or cell transition occurs.
identityAndBodyMapping.hpConditionsEquipmentCargoAndCustody: This type update changes none of current HP, maximum HP, conditions, equipment, carried items, cargo ownership or custody.
identityAndBodyMapping.fitRequirement: Occupied volume is unchanged, so this proposed rule requires no changed-volume fit calculation and does not displace any creature or object.

taxonomyAndInteractions.duration: Propose permanent taxonomy after successful transformation, with no concentration requirement and no automatic expiry or reversion.
taxonomyAndInteractions.terminationAndReversion: This proposal defines no separate termination or reversion mechanism; no automatic removal occurs. Any dispel, voluntary removal, death-state or future reversion rule is outside this proposal and must come from an accepted source.
taxonomyAndInteractions.targeting: Propose the existing ancestry interaction at ANCESTRY_BACKGROUND_PLAYTEST.md line 131: an effect requiring either type may apply; an explicit exclusion of either type excludes the character.
taxonomyAndInteractions.lifeState: Describe the result as the same active creature life state, not a corpse; do not exempt the character from Undead targeting.

abilitiesAndAcquisition.existingUnlocks: Preserve only the ritual's existing successful Lich path and elite-companion unlocks. Each card, companion and feature retains its printed acquisition and use requirements; taxonomy does not grant or accelerate any of them.
